contentText: Donald Trump is travelling to Beijing where he will be hosted by Xi Jinping. On the agenda is a series of issues that could cement the superiority of one over the other, and even lead to a new world order. Because beneath the diplomatic and friendly langaage there are messages that will be hard to disgest for someone. Behind the handshake there’s a likely arm wrestle over who has dibs where and when in the world. Our panel will dissect what’s at stake and I hope answer your questions in what is the mopst testing of times.
